_comment: Durable editorial corrections, re-applied on EVERY content refresh (content-refresh.js Task 21d, via scripts/lib/content-corrections.js). They exist because the arrays they fix are re-scraped from scratch every 6 hours, so editing js/gov-helpers.js directly fixes nothing. Rows are written by scripts/content-autofix.js -- deterministic ones automatically, judgment ones via a pull request -- and can be hand-edited or deleted at any time. kind: event-date | clear-link | set-link | drop-event | fix-title. A row matches on array + normalized title + the date the SOURCE currently publishes (wrongDate), so it goes inert the moment the source corrects itself. EVERY ROW EXPIRES: expiresOn is required and pruned automatically, because a permanent override silently distorts data long after the source fixed its own mistake.

corrections.reason: Morgan 2026-08-16: remove the event rather than relink it. The per-event Squarespace URL 404s and the remaining entries are past. Deliberately NOT date-scoped, because TJC_EVENTS stores pubDate as a Date object which wrongDate cannot match; a short expiry is the safety valve instead, so a genuinely new Shabbat is not suppressed for long.
Link returned 404 on 3+ consecutive daily runs. Event kept, dead href cleared.

corrections.titleMatch: An Evening with Ken Burns & Telluride Historical Museum
corrections.reason: KOTO publishes this event twice under two slugs (an-evening-with-ken-burns and an-evening-with-ken-burns-telluride-historical-museum), same date and 17:30 start, so the exact-duplicate rule in sanitizeRecords cannot see it -- the links differ. Dropping the LONGER title, not the shorter one, on purpose: the kept entry carries the poster image (the co-presenter copy has imageUrl empty) and its title matches TELLURIDE_COM_EVENTS exactly, so cross-source dedup collapses the two into a single card. Keeping the fuller title instead would leave two cards, one per source.

corrections.titleMatch: Ongiong: Space Cowboy by Dundee & Lee
corrections.correctTitle: Ongoing: Space Cowboy by Dundee & Lee
corrections.reason: 'Ongiong' is a typo for 'Ongoing' on the Ouray/Ridgway Localist listing. A one-off source misspelling, so it is corrected by name rather than by a spell-check rule that would eventually rename a real event.
